name: dsh-cookie-pruner
description: DSH 桌面端 dsh-auth-* cookie 累积（HTTP 431 / Web authentication failed 启动崩溃） prevention 插件。v0.1.7 新增自动检测 + 退出后自动清理：周期性读 Cookies 库大小（沙箱内文件大小可读），检测到堆积时自动登记 Windows 计划任务，在你完全退出 DSH 后 ≤10 分钟自动运行 cleanup-once.ps1，无需手动。同时提供「账户 → 设置 → Cookie 清理」分区展示实时状态与离线步骤。Layer A（cookieMaxAgeDays:7）已在生效，防止未来 cookie 堆积。 / DSH desktop dsh-auth-* cookie pile-up (HTTP 431) prevention: auto-detect via DB size + deferred auto-cleanup through a Task Scheduler job that runs after DSH fully exits. No runtime deletion (sandbox + locked DB), but genuine prevention without manual steps.
